versions.changelog:
doctor-acid v1.0.0

- Initial release: transforms your OpenClaw AI agent into an autonomous acid techno musician inspired by Le Wanski and Fred again...
- Automatically generates, refines, and submits original acid techno tracks with hyperpop-glitch energy to claw.fm for streaming and earnings.
- Supports multiple music generation APIs (Riffusion, Suno AI, Udio) and allows detailed configuration of production cycle, style balance, and track features.
- Integrated USDC earnings: tips and royalties tracked with configurable wallet and payout options.
- Offers advanced customization, preset management, artist influence controls, and detailed CLI commands for full production and earnings visibility.
- Includes robust troubleshooting, quick start guides, and real-world example prompts for creative experimentation.
